profile_text.body:
Arthur AI is a company that provides an AI governance platform aimed at enterprise organizations. The company describes itself as offering a unified control plane that brings together security teams, finance teams, and AI developers to oversee AI systems across their full lifecycle. Its platform covers AI discovery across endpoints, cloud environments, and private data centers, as well as policy enforcement, real-time guardrails, and observability.

The company's core product, also called Arthur AI, includes model monitoring, bias mitigation, fairness metrics, and compliance reporting. A notable feature is Agent Behavioral Analytics, which the company describes as continuously monitoring AI applications for anomalous behavior, suspicious patterns, and indicators of compromise. The platform also tracks AI spending by team and user, and can automatically reroute requests away from expensive models, including toward internally hosted open-source alternatives. One customer testimonial cited in the site's materials states that Arthur is expected to reduce maintenance workload by 50 percent.

The held facts confirm Arthur AI has a tracked product page on theworldofai.org under the AI Governance and Risk Management Platforms category. No litigation, MCP server registry presence, SEC filings, or patent records are noted in the available data.
